capabilities: Log practice sessions with minutes, BPM, quality rating and review results
Run a practice timer from the status bar with pause and forgotten-timer handling
Plan a session for the available time and rank what to practice next
Track mastery levels and schedule spaced review of items
Render and play chord, scale, fretboard, progression and tablature blocks
extras: Optional 14.9 MB sound pack is the only network use, downloaded from jsDelivr and hash-checked; the full user guide is hosted outside the README. Interface available in English and French, with note syntax and stored values kept in English.
motivation: The author was learning guitar and piano again and wanted practice to live next to the rest of their notes, with a system that says what to work on next.
problem: Practice material piles up as songs and exercises you never return to, with no system telling you what to work on next.

relations.evidence: Works with the Obsidian Starter Kit (note types, folders, templates and statuses come from it)

summary: Practice tracker for instruments that logs sessions with a timer, plans practice, tracks mastery with spaced review, and renders chord and tab diagrams.
